items.stem: Distinguish between a rights issue and a bonus issue.
items.answer: A rights issue raises new cash by selling shares to existing shareholders in proportion to their holdings; a bonus issue gives free shares by converting reserves into share capital, raising no cash.

items.stem: Explain why a company might make a bonus issue.
